# Safe & Responsible AI Use at Work — key ideas (one page)

## What you can now do

- Apply the company AI policy
- Recognise prompt-injection and deepfake risks
- Know when disclosure is required
- Know how to report an AI incident

## The sentences to remember

1. **Allowed or not? Ten scenarios against the policy** — “Two questions decide almost everything: is the tool approved, and what class of data is this?”
2. **Spot the attack: injection, leakage and deepfake fraud** — “You cannot hear a deepfake. You can always hear an unusual request. Verify the request, not the voice.”
3. **Is this an incident? Triage and report** — “Reporting fast is never the mistake. Hiding it for a week is.”
